These results support phase II clinical trial data to BRAF inhibitors [44, 45]. Screening also revealed that combinatorial therapy of encorafenib and a MEK inhibitor binimetinib was markedly better than single treatment with the latter, improving response rate to 100% in BRAF-mutated PDXs.   "what_the_study_did": "This study is a compilation of methods and protocols for using patient-derived xenografts (PDXs) in cancer research and drug development.",
  "what_it_found": "PDXs are valuable preclinical models that closely mimic human tumors, aiding in understanding cancer biology, identifying biomarkers, screening drugs, and advancing personalized medicine, despite facing challenges such as metastatic potential variability and stromal changes.",
  "key_quotes": [
    {
      "quote": "Patient-derived xenografts (PDXs) represent a critical advancement in preclinical cancer research, wherein human tumor samples are implanted into animal models for evaluation of therapeutic responses.",
      "topic": "PDX definition"
    },
    {
      "quote": "PDXs have emerged as indispensable tools in translational cancer research, facilitating investigation into tumor microenvironments and personalized medicine.",
      "topic": "PDX importance"
    },
    {
      "quote": "Evidently, these models have demonstrated inadequate predictive ability in terms of clinical outcomes, with a staggering 90% of potential therapeutics that pass preclinical stages failing in human trials due to inefficacy [52, 53].",
      "topic": "Model limitations"
    },
    {
      "quote": "PDXs provide a biologically stable and precise reflection of the patient’s tumor, including gene transcription, epigenetic modulations, genetic variation, histopathology, inflammation, and circumstances of responses toward treatments [9].",
      "topic": "PDX fidelity"
    },
    {
      "quote": "PDXs have become a cornerstone of cancer research, offering insights into mechanobiology, metastasis, tumorigenesis, and the preclinical evaluation of anticancer therapies with the goal of advancing personalized cancer treatment strategies.",
      "topic": "PDX applications"
    },

      "quote": "Despite their many advantages, PDX models present certain challenges.     }
